component.name: Picnest
component.summary: Every photo and video on your computer in one library

description.p: Picnest is a fast, modern photo and video gallery for GNOME. It automatically finds every photo and video on your internal drives and connected external drives and presents them in one beautifully organized library, so you never have to dig through folders again.

ul.li: Automatic discovery across all drives with real-time updates
A single mixed grid for photos and videos that stays smooth with hundreds of thousands of items
Days, months and years views, favorites, albums, folders, recents and memories
Smart collections for screenshots, panoramas and duplicates
Instant search with filters for date, type, camera, album, size, resolution and orientation
A full-screen viewer with zoom, rotation, EXIF details, a filmstrip and slideshows
A video player with speed control and picture-in-picture
A built-in editor with crop, rotate, filters and color adjustments
A hidden album with optional password protection and a trash with automatic cleanup

description.p: Created by Junaid Ul Hassan, Software Engineer.
Live Photos support has been removed.
New red parrot app icon. The Map view has been removed.
Individual drives can be turned off and on in Preferences.
TypeScript files indexed by earlier versions are removed from the library.
New app icon, and TypeScript files are no longer listed as videos.
